breakdown.description: Stokes (creeping-flow) drag is applied at a Reynolds number that is not in the creeping-flow regime.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification directly applies the Stokes drag formula (Fd = 3πμDV) without computing the Reynolds number, without recognizing that Re ≈ 2500 is far outside the creeping-flow regime (Re << 1), and without switching to an appropriate drag-coefficient correlation (Cd(Re)) with Fd = (1/2)ρV²CdA as the ground truth requires. The agent repeated the original error.
